get.summary: Get content by given content reference or unique identifier and language.

parameters.name: contentIdentifier
parameters.description: Content reference or unique identifier to retrieve data.

parameters.name: Accept-Language
parameters.description: Determines in which language the content should be retrieved. Example: 'en' or 'sv'. Does not support fallback.

parameters.name: expand
parameters.description: List of properties needed to be expanded. The list is separated by comma

parameters.name: select
parameters.description: List of properties needed to be returned. The list is separated by comma. Default are all properties returned

get.summary: Get the children of the content item by given content reference or unique identifier and language.

parameters.name: contentIdentifier
parameters.description: Parent's content reference or parent's unique identifier.

parameters.name: Accept-Language
parameters.description: Determines in which language the content should be retrieved. Example: 'en' or 'sv'. Does not support fallback.

parameters.name: expand
parameters.description: List of properties needed to be expanded. The list is separated by comma

parameters.name: select
parameters.description: List of properties needed to be returned. The list is separated by comma. Default are all properties returned

parameters.name: top
parameters.description: The max number of children to return.

parameters.name: x-epi-continuation
parameters.description: The max number of children to return.

get.summary: Get the ancestors of the content item by given content reference or unique identifier and language.

parameters.name: contentIdentifier
parameters.description: Content reference or unique identifier to retrieve parents.

parameters.name: Accept-Language
parameters.description: Determines in which language the content should be retrieved. Example: 'en' or 'sv'. Does not support fallback.

parameters.name: expand
parameters.description: List of properties needed to be expanded. The list is separated by comma

parameters.name: select
parameters.description: List of properties needed to be returned. The list is separated by comma. Default are all properties returned

get.summary: Get content by given content url or by list of GUID/Reference with given language

parameters.name: Accept-Language
parameters.description: Determines in which language the content should be retrieved. Example: 'en' or 'sv'. Does not support fallback.

parameters.name: ContentUrl
parameters.description: The absolute url to the content

parameters.name: Guids
parameters.description: List of GUID separated by ','.

parameters.name: References
parameters.description: List of ContentReference separated by ','.

parameters.name: Expand
parameters.description: List of properties needed to be expanded. The list is separated by comma.

parameters.name: Select
parameters.description: List of properties needed to be returned. The list is separated by comma. Default are all properties returned.

parameters.name: MatchExact
parameters.description: Indicates if the specified 'contentUrl' should match url of the content exactly, that is no additional segments are allowed.

get.summary: Gets the site with the provided identifier.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The identifier of the site.
